id: title:arnohillen:warn when a scanner has no recording filters

review.posthog_relevance: Replay Vision scanner warning banner and recording filter UI
review.reason: Adds a utility function `groupHasNoFilters` and its unit tests to detect empty filter configurations, alongside a UI change removing potentially misleading instructions. This supports the Replay Vision scanner's warning banner and recording filter UI. No tier assignment performed.
review.uncertainty: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.

observations.behavior: Adds a new utility function groupHasNoFilters and its unit tests, and a warning banner shown when no recording filters are set.
observations.posthog_connection: Replay Vision scanner: this function checks if the filter group lacks any leaf filters, distinguishing an empty configuration from a group containing only other groups, which is necessary to correctly decide whether to show the warning banner.

observations.behavior: Adds unit tests for groupHasNoFilters, including edge cases for nested empty groups and groups with leaf filters.
observations.posthog_connection: Replay Vision scanner: these tests verify the correctness of the no-filter detection, preventing false positives where an outer group wrapping an empty inner group is incorrectly treated as having filters.

observations.behavior: Removes the explanatory text 'Leave empty to scan all completed recordings.' from the Recording filters label.
observations.code_quote: Filter by event, action, person, session, or cohort.
observations.posthog_connection: Replay Vision scanner: this removes the instruction that could encourage users to leave filters empty, aligning the UI with the new warning behavior.
